home.title: Bloomworks Solo Helper
home.play1: Play Bloomworks against Lady Pei, the solo opponent.
home.play2: This application replaces the Automa cards, the Solo Board, manages the market prices and Lady Pei's garden and guides you through the game flow.

milestoneSeasonOrder.title: Milestone Board: Season Order
milestoneSeasonOrder.description: Arrange the season tiles on the milestone board in this order:

botMode.title: Solo Mode
botMode.advancedNote: Choose any Player Power you wish to play. See if you can beat Lady Pei with every character!

instructions.intro: Set up a complete two-player game, with the following changes:
instructions.botUnusedComponents: Your opponent, Lady Pei, doesn't receive any starting money. Her garden is managed by the application.
instructions.firstPlayer: You are always the first player.
instructions.chooseSetupCard: Draw three Setup cards. Choose your Setup card and place the flowers shown into their matching seasons in your garden. Then choose one flower from any family to add to your garden in the Autumn.
instructions.marketPricesManaged: The flower market prices are managed by this application. Whenever you do an action that affects prices (buying, selling) the price needs to be adjusted in the application. You can do that by clicking on the related price row in the sidebar of the application.
instructions.botComponentsNotRequired: The Automa card deck and the solo board is not required. You can keep the solo board nearby for reference if you like.

playerFlowerSelection.description: Select the 3 or 4 flower colors you planted in your garden.
playerFlowerSelection.flowerPriorityNote: The order of flowers reflects Lady Pei's flower priority.
playerFlowerSelection.validationHint: Please select the flower colors you planted in your garden.

roundTurnPlayer.passConfirm: Do you really want to pass?

action.managedByApp: This action is managed by the application.

plant.title: Plant
plant.plant: Lady Pei adds the most expensive flower to her garden.
plant.reducePrice: The price of that flower is reduced by 1.

xp.title: XP
xp.receiveXP: Lady Pei receives one XP in the Flower Family in which your Player Marker is the greatest distance ahead of Lady Pei’s.
xp.priority: If you aren’t ahead of Lady Pei in any tracks, she follows this priority:
xp.stars: Stars - Whenever Lady Pei reaches a star on the Floriculture Track or her Garden, she scores points equal to her XP in that flower less your XP in that flower. If you are further along the track than she is, Lady Pei receives no points.

action.abortGameConfirm: Aborting the running game - are you sure?
action.endGameConfirm: End this game and return to home screen - are you sure?
